description: This file contains shell script code that sets up and tests Git hook behavior related to the 'proc-receive' hook in a Git server environment. It performs push operations and verifies the output, simulating multiple ref rewrites and related hook behaviors.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a 'proc-receive' hook with specified behavior for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success if the following commands execute correctly.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output into a stable, readable format for comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves the expected output for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output to an expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references between local and remote repositories.
